onboarding.title: Welcome to Kevrai Omni — three steps to get started
onboarding.step1Body: Open the AI Engines page and install the engine you need (e.g. llama.cpp). Engines download on demand; installed ones are skipped automatically.
onboarding.step2Body: Search the Model Market and install a model (e.g. Qwen3.8 GGUF). You can also drag model files from your disk straight in.
onboarding.step3Body: Chat, draw, make video: pick a model → type a prompt → hit generate. That's it.
onboarding.gatedHint: Models marked ⓘ are gated. Before downloading, fill in your HF Token under Settings.

mnn.title: ⬢ MNN inference engine (Alibaba open-source)
mnn.hint: On-device speed demon: CPU asm-level optimization + GPU backends, often faster than llama.cpp for Qwen families. Installed via pip (bundles the full LLM runtime); models are official pre-converted MNN format (taobao-mnn), download and run.
mnn.marketTitle: MNN model market (official pre-converted · ready to run)
mnn.notLoaded: No model loaded yet — download one from the market below, or click “Load” on a downloaded model.
mnn.installHint: Click the button on the right to install via pip (~60MB, includes the full LLM runtime). China mirror acceleration preconfigured.
mnn.chatPlaceholder: Type a message, Enter to send…
mnn.noModels: No MNN models downloaded yet. Pick one from the market below — small models (LFM2.5-230M ~0.2GB) finish in seconds.
mnn.descMllm: Convert raw HF weights to MNN-LLM format (prefers official llm-export, falls back to MNNConvert).
mnn.descGguf: Export GGUF with llama.cpp's convert_hf_to_gguf.py; works directly with llama.cpp / ollama.
mnn.descOnnx: Export ONNX with HuggingFace Optimum's optimum-cli.
mnn.descMlx: Export MLX format with mlx_lm.convert, for Apple Silicon.
mnn.descConvert: Convert ONNX models to MNN format with MNNConvert.
mnn.noDownloaded: No MNN models downloaded yet. Pick one from the marketplace below — small models finish in seconds.
